sources.snippet: An open-source, ultra-lightweight AI assistant tailored specifically for Medical AI Research. Powered by an underlying micro-agent framework, Mira is designed to execute complex medical imaging pipelines, from raw DICOM data processing to deep learning tasks, traditional radiomics, and survival analysis.
